worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 1) 40,000.00 + military retirement pay (person 0) 60,000.00 + taxable Social Security 29,750.00 = 129,750.00. Federal taxable income = 129,750.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction - 2 x 1,600.00 age 65 additional = 95,050.00 (the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form 40 (filing status married filing jointly): line 7 federal AGI 129,750.00. Line 8 additions 0.00; line 9 = 129,750.00 + 0.00 = 129,750.00. Form 39R Part B line 7 Social Security and railroad benefits included in federal income = 29,750.00 + 0.00 = 29,750.00. Line 8 retirement benefits deduction: line 8a 72,324.00; line 8b railroad benefits received 0.00; line 8c Social Security received (gross, both spouses, Box 5) 35,000.00; line 8d = 72,324.00 - 0.00 - 35,000.00, not below zero, = 37,324.00; line 8e (person 0 age 70: 60,000.00 qualifies, age 62 or older) = 60,000.00; line 8f smaller of 8d and 8e = 37,324.00. Line 18 health insurance premiums: none in the inputs, 0.00. Line 24 total subtractions = 29,750.00 + 37,324.00 = 67,074.00. Form 40 line 10 67,074.00; line 11 total adjusted income = 129,750.00 - 67,074.00 = 62,676.00. Line 12a boxes checked 2. Standard Deduction Worksheet: line 1 31,500.00; line 4 31,500.00; line 5 2 x 1,600.00 = 3,200.00; line 6 34,700.00. Line 15 0.00 (no Schedule A); line 16 34,700.00. Line 17 = 62,676.00 - 34,700.00 = 27,976.00. Line 18 federal Form 1040 lines 13a and 13b taken as 0.00; line 19 Idaho taxable income 27,976.00. Line 20 worksheet: line 1 27,976.00; line 2 9,622.00; line 3 = 18,354.00; line 4 at 5.3%; line 5 tax = 18,354.00 x 5.3% = 972.762, to the cent 972.76 (the return rounds to whole dollars, PDF p.8, and shows 973; expected keeps the formula). Lines 21-24 credits 0.00; line 25 0.00; line 26 972.76. Food Tax Credit Worksheet (Form 40 line 43): 2 x 155.00 = 310.00. State income tax = 972.76 - 310.00 = 662.76. Line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax 10.00 is on the return but the projection does not charge it (approximations). Line 18 would take any federal Schedule 1-A amount, the senior deduction included; it is ignored here and the projection does not subtract it (approximations). Gross benefits of both spouses reduce the maximum, the non-pensioner's included, and the taxable 29,750.00 is still subtracted on line 7.
